subject: Security Alert: Password Reset for $username - $system_name
body:
ADMIN NOTIFICATION - Password Reset

A password has been reset via security questions.

Account Details:
  Username:     $username
  Display Name: $display_name
  Email:        $email
  User ID:      $user_id
  Reset Time:   $reset_time
  Method:       Security Questions

A temporary password has been issued. The user will be required to change their password on next login.

If this reset was not expected, please investigate and consider disabling the account.

-- $system_name Administration
